avis.titre: Glowy serum with great smooth consistency!

I typically use the serum after my toners and lighter/thinner serums and I feel like it has been really easy to fit into my routine. The smell of the serum is a little different than a typical vitamin C serum, it kind of has a liquor/orange Jell-O shot type of smell to it, which isn't necessarily bad, I know some vitamin C serums really have offputting smells, this one isn't bad it's definitely just different. Overall I've been loving it, and I will continue to use long-term in my routine for the glow that it provides!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am in my 30s and have acne-prone, combination skin. I love vitamin c products for brightening my dark spots, as I definitely get acne scar/post acne hyperpigmentation, so I was excited to try out this serum. The serum is a gel-serum consistency and I appreciate that it is in a convenient pump bottle. The serum smells nicely like oranges, it spreads easily on my skin and absorbs nicely, while leaving my skin hydrated, but is not heavy, oily, or greasy. It works well under my usual products and makeup. It also doesn't irritate my skin nor cause any breakouts which I appreciate. From the limited time I used it, I feel my skin does look slightly smoother and slightly brighter— but doesn't seem to do much on my acne scars. I've got other vitamin C products that are more effective at fading my acne scars, but I would say this is a nice gentle vitamin c product, with an elegant formula for those who have sensitive skin. Overall, I'll happily use up my bottle, but I think I'll go with my Japanese vitamin C product that works more effectively for my scars in the future.

My skin looks more radiant, feels softer, and just overall healthier. Plus the citrus scent? So fresh and energizing, it makes skincare feels like a whole experience. Basically a daily glow boost in a bottle. 🧡

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wanted to like this product, but I could not confidently recommend this to someone. First off, the smell. It smells like a fresh orange that has gone slightly sour. And it's an overpowering smell. I won't be able to continue to use this on my face, unfortunately. My next concern is the texture. It feels great out of the bottle, but then feels very sticky on the face. Look elsewhere for a Vitamin C serum.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been loving this light weight serum as an addition to my daily skincare routine. The glass bottle packaging is very high end and removes plastics from another area of my life and I appreciate it! The pump is easy to use and dispenses a small, even amount. I'm happy that the pump is slow so I don't waste any of the product. There's no overwhelming smell which is another big thing I love about this product. It goes on and makes my skin very smooth. I love how hydrated my face looks and feels from using the product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin just did not like this product. I broke out immediately after using it. I'm sure it would be great for someone with a different skin type but it did not work out for me. I do love the bottle and how it twists to lock the pump. There also doesn't seem like much product in the bottle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The quality of the serum is amazing! It is a very safe and reliable vitamin c serum. The design is very sleek and ergonomic! Olehenriksen is an amazing brand and one of my all time favorites!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin C serum from Ole Henriksen smells wonderful. I began using this product incredibly sparingly as I've heard there can be an adjustment period with Vitamin C. I'm glad I did because my skin did peel a little. However, the peeling was worth it because my skin looks a lot clearer and brighter. I look forward to finishing this bottle.

avis.titre: Easily fits into my skincare routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I use this following my skin serum and not only do I love the smell, but it keeps my skin feeling dewy all day. It seamlessly fits into my daily skincare routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum gives such a fresh, radiant glow to the skin. It has a lightweight texture that sinks in quickly and layers really nicely under moisturizer and makeup. I love the subtle citrus scent, it makes my routine feel a little more luxe and refreshing. Over time, my skin looks brighter and more even, and it gives that healthy, lit from within glow without feeling greasy. It's a great everyday serum if you want smoother, more radiant skin without anything too heavy or complicated.

avis.titre: Hydrating and brightening sign me up!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Anything vitamin C sign me up and do I was very excited to try this. This is a lightweight spreadable serum that leaves skin feeling smooth. You don't feel sticky after and smells great like citrus. Leaves skin feeling hydrated and looking brighter. Highly recommend this product

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love love love the fresh and bright scent of this serum! It is so refreshing. One little pump goes a long way and really helps my face feel awake and hydrated, without feeling sticky at all.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a heavier serum that ultimately absorbs beautifully. The vitamin C is potent and provides a delightful tingle that is tame yet satisfying.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This compact bottle of vitamin c is my go to for my facial maintenance and care. The product is effective and I can notice it working it's magic a week in. Would definitely refill this

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin c serum is wonderful! The pump is easy to use and mess free. The texture of the serum is a little bit more thicker almost like a gel consistency which I really like. It smells just like oranges I love it! It makes my skin look and feel really smooth but I also noticed a huge difference in the brightness of my skin within a week or so of use!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like this serum. I was looking for a vitamin c, brightening serum. This is light weight and effective. I'm using it daily twice a day. This one also has aloe Vera.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I actually really like this product. I had doubts at first but after a few days I noticed a difference in my skins glow. It applies very well and sinks into your skin. It smells amazing and not over powering. Very easy to use and goes well under makeup. I like the pump feature even though I feel like it pumps too much. Little goes a long way.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vitamin c serum smells so good, makes my skin feel brighter, and is great for an easy morning or evening use. Compared to other serums I've used this one is definitely thinner which means it not only spreads across my skin better but is also used faster.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is life! First, it was easy to get started. Just a few pumps and it's good to go. It's vitamin c which I desperately needed. My skin was looking dull and started to show crows feet around my eyes. Also, I have combination skin so it's hard to find a serum that can work on both normal and oily skin at the same time. It controlled my shine but also gave a glow to my skin. It felt more firm than it has in a while. I definitely recommend this serum!

avis.titre: New addition to my morning skincare routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I LOVE this serum! it's not sticky and not causing me breakouts, I will have to see for the results in a few weeks I guess, but it's been added to my morning skincare routine ✨️

Love this product! My skin looks like glass. I feel so beautiful. The consistency is tightening and nourishing! Great add to my routine! It makes maintenence a breeze. Such a great product for all! If youre looking for a go to that addresses all skin this is it!

avis.titre: Luxury product at a great price!
avis.texte: I received this product for an honest review. Out of all the Vitamin C serums I've tried this True C-Complex with Aloe Vera extract serum is by far my favorite! A little goes a long way, the price point is perfect for the amount you get, and it leaves my face feeling refreshed and soft when applying at night before my lotion. If you have more sensitive skin and looking for a vitamin C serum I highly reccomend this serum from OLEHENRIKSEN.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This vit C serum is thickkkk! That may not be for everyone but I don't mind it. It smells like oranges and it's a little sticky but gets absorbed quickly! Once absorbed, my skin felt hydrated and looked healthier.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked this product. It was easy to use and my non-sensitive skin didnt have any irritation. I use prescription meds on my face in the PM and it worked well alongside. I wish the bottle wasnt clear (can reduce potency) and that there wasnt fragrance but I like it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is a new staple in my skin care routine. It smells wonderful (like oranges), it makes my skin glow, and though a little sticky when first applied it ends up feeling great on skin! One pump is all you need for your skin to feel hydrated. Great product!
The truth serum has a fruity smell that is quite pleasant. Like that it is not a heavy cream. It's a light film that is supposed to be followed up by a moisturizer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The serum does a great job of triggering and refreshing my skin. The serum is high quality and made a noticeable difference after just a few uses.

I received the OLEHENRIKSEN Truth Serum and it's been a great addition to my routine. It feels light on the skin and gives a nice glow without being greasy. I've noticed my skin looks more even and hydrated. Super easy to use daily!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Pretty thick texture, that surprisingly glides very well onto skin, and gets absorbed momentarily even by oily skin. The pump is very convenient, and one pump is enough for my entire face. The glass bottle gives luxury, seems very durable, and has a decent amount of product in it. The product itself has an amazing citrus scent, that doesn't linger long on skin. This serum makes my skin feel soft and supple to the touch, and gives inner radiance instantly. I also noticed soft improvement in irritation and redness, which made this serum very suitable for my skin concerns.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a light clear serum, sometimes vitamin c creams can feel a bit heavy so this serum is great because is light and hydrating Class bottle with a pump so the product stays intact and not open to the elements Leaves skin hydrated and bright radiant look without looking oily Good ingredients and antioxidants However vitamin c products in general are not for everyone/skin type Avoid if you have very sensitive skin Don't forget to apply spf after use Has a light orange scent but not terrible Easy to travel with braces it's under 100ml

This is the absolute BEST vitamin C serum I have ever used and I don't bother trying anything else anymore. It's expensive so I do try to buy it when I can get it discounted but a little goes a long way. I use it in the morning, fresh out of the shower, one pump of this covers my whole face and neck. I use an ice roller after applying it. My skin is SO smooth and also bright. I think it's worth every penny and the smell is also amazing.

avis.titre: The smell alone is worth the purchase
avis.texte: It does work. You can feel the tightening and I look forward to my evening routine. I use the milky toner also and I love it!!
Received this as a sample last year.. I am hooked. Leaves skin soft and ready for my moisturizer.

Love this serum. I mix it with their other vitamin C serum and use in my daily skincare routing. Between this product and the toner, I am seeing a large improvement in hyperpigmentation/ dark spots and I am so grateful!
Really wanted to love this because I love all me other OH products, but unfortunately this made my skin incredibly red, inflamed and hot to the touch. I wish I never tried it or put it on my skin.

avis.titre: Always Part of My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I like to try different skincare products. Ole Henriksen is one of my favorite brands and I've tried most of their product lines. No matter what I am experimenting with, this is my go to serum. I love the absorption and "slip" of the application. The results of hydrated, brighter skin are noticeable.
I'm not sure why I keep trying other vitamin c serums. I've tried less expensive and more expensive and ALWAYS come back to this one. My skin is instantly glowy and plump. It also calms my redness.
Really makes an instant improvement in hydration. I love that I can also buy it in mini for travel. Smells great and isn't sticky. Perfect texture. Love it!
I have been using truth serum for years. This product really works!!!

avis.titre: I have used this line for years.
avis.texte: I have used this line for years. I do switch it up with another brand every once in a while. I use it every morning, along with the skin brightener moisturizer and eye cream. I always get compliments on my skin
I used this for a while and stopped.... but my skin missed it. So I'm back to stay.
Allergic reaction started on neck and face, then whole body got puffy, red, inflamed. Returning this product. Will probably discontinue other Ole Henrikson products as well.
Used once and within 2 minutes of applying my face was inflamed, red, burning and then itching through the whole day and into the night

This has been in my skin care routine for almost 10 years and I really can't live without it now. It's one of the best products ever. Helps with wrinkle after consistently using and makes your face look so glowy!!! Seriously an amazing product!
I am on my second bottle of this vitamin C. I love this product and will continue to buy it. It makes my skin feel so moisturized.
